categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai V-Test Semiconductor Tech. Co., Ltd primarily operates in integrated circuit (IC) testing services, including wafer testing (Chip Probing) and chip final testing (Final Test). The company also provides related supporting services such as testing equipment leasing and sales of testing consumables. It focuses on high-end chips, automotive-grade chips, industrial-grade chips, and high-computing power chips, serving strategic emerging industries like AI, cloud computing, IoT, 5G, new energy vehicles, and high-end consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary IC testing technologies with advanced testing equipment platforms such as Advantest V93000, Teradyne J750, and Chroma. It has developed complex SoC testing solutions for CPUs, GPUs, AI chips, RF chips, and automotive-grade chips, achieving domestic substitution of imported technologies. Production is highly automated with a self-developed production management system that integrates IT for automated, intelligent, and efficient testing operations, ensuring high accuracy and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: V-Test serves over 200 customers including chip design companies, wafer manufacturers, packaging firms, and IDM enterprises. Notable clients include domestic and international leaders such as Unisoc, ZTE Microelectronics, Fudan Microelectronics, Bitmain, SMIC, and others. The end markets span communications, computing, automotive electronics, industrial control, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shanghai with subsidiaries in Wuxi, Nanjing, and Shenzhen, strategically located in major Chinese semiconductor clusters such as the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta regions. Its sales and service coverage primarily focus on domestic Chinese markets, extending from the Yangtze River Delta to the Pearl River Delta and northern regions including Beijing and Jilin.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai V-Test operates as a midstream independent third-party IC testing service provider within the semiconductor supply chain. It does not engage in chip design, wafer fabrication, or packaging but specializes exclusively in testing services, providing neutral and objective quality assurance between upstream manufacturing and downstream packaging or end-use.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-computing power chips, automotive-grade and industrial-grade high-reliability chips, and advanced testing solutions for 5nm to 14nm process nodes. It focuses on overcoming testing challenges for complex SoCs, RF chips, and high-performance CPUs, while enhancing automation and digitalization of production. R&D expenditure increased significantly in 2023, reflecting a strategic emphasis on innovation and capacity expansion to capture growth in emerging chip segments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IC testing services, including wafer testing and chip final testing. The company operates on a service contract basis with customers placing orders for testing services, and revenue is recognized upon delivery of testing results and receipt of payment. Additional revenue streams include leasing of testing equipment and sales of testing consumables.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: V-Test is one of the largest domestic independent third-party IC testing companies in China, positioned behind leading Taiwanese firms like King Yuan Electronics, Siliconware Precision Industries, and XINQUAN Technology. While still developing compared to these global leaders, V-Test holds a leading position in mainland China, especially in high-end chip testing capacity and technology, and is recognized for its strong R&D and customer base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 736.5 million, a slight increase of 0.48% over 2022, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 117.99 million, down 51.57% due to increased R&D and stock-based compensation expenses. Total assets reached RMB 3.61 billion, growing 6.57%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 2.46 billion, up 3.31%. The company has steadily expanded its scale through capacity investments and increased R&D spending.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: V-Test emphasizes its technological leadership in testing complex, high-performance, automotive-grade, and industrial-grade chips with advanced testing solutions and high automation levels. Its neutral third-party testing model ensures objective and reliable results, differentiating it from integrated packaging and testing providers. The company’s strong customer relationships, extensive testing capacity, and focus on emerging strategic industries underpin its competitive advantage.
